title: Uncertainty-Aware LSTM with Monte Carlo Dropout and Shot-Chart Embeddings
source: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets (MDPI Information, Jan 8 2026)
technique: Replace or augment GBT backbone with LSTM + Monte Carlo Dropout ingesting rolling team-level efficiency metrics, spatial shot-chart embeddings (CNN over court zones), and form indicators. Run N=50 stochastic forward passes for calibrated win-probability distribution. Apply Platt scaling post-hoc on GBT outputs as low-effort first step; paper reports logistic regression Brier 0.199 and XGBoost 0.202 on 2024 season with strict chronological splits.

title: TabPFN v2 as Drop-In Calibrated Classifier over Existing Feature Set
source: TabPFN v2 / TabPFN-2.5 — Nature 2024; TabArena benchmark 2025 (arXiv 2511.08667v1)
technique: Swap GBT model for TabPFN v2 using existing evolution-selected feature set as-is. Bayesian prior-fitted transformer with inherent calibration, zero hyperparameter tuning, runs in seconds. Test on <=10k rows; if dataset is larger use TabPFN as meta-learner in stacking ensemble on top of existing GBT. Targets Brier score directly.
estimated_brier_improvement: 0.010-0.018 reduction depending on dataset size and feature quality

title: Player-Impact Feature Augmentation via EPM/RAPTOR + Stacked Ensemble
source: Stacked Ensemble for NBA Game Outcome Prediction (Nature Scientific Reports, Aug 2025); EPM data dunksandthrees.com/epm
technique: Enrich feature set with EPM, RAPTOR, or LEBRON player-impact ratings aggregated per team roster per game: sum/average top-8-minute-weighted player EPM values for pre-game team-strength delta. Feed enriched set into stacked ensemble (GBT base + logistic meta-learner). EPM updated daily, ML-optimized for next-game prediction. Additive to existing evolution-based selector.
